intro.h2: See the whole slab before it becomes your countertop
paragraphs: Most places show you a one-foot sample. At Raccoon Stone & Tile Works, our stone countertops in Byron, GA start in a yard full of full-size slabs, so you can see the veining and color of the actual piece that goes in your kitchen. We cut it only after you are happy with it.

Reviewers notice what happens next. One said our template visit took four hours and the install was an absolute perfect fit. Another, with a multi-angled kitchen, watched our cutter match the natural pattern at every joint so the seams look almost seamless. That care is the whole point of choosing a local fabricator.

about.h2: A stone shop with a yard you can walk
about.text: Raccoon Stone & Tile Works is a stone fabricator and kitchen remodeler on the Highway 247 Connector in Byron, serving central Georgia. Our yard and showroom are open weekdays, and you are welcome to come browse the slabs and meet the team. We have been cutting stone for a long time: in 2007 we were selected to create the altar, ambo, tabernacle base and baptismal font at Sacred Heart, a job that let us stretch our fabrication skills. Today most of our work is kitchen countertops, along with stone accents for powder rooms, laundry rooms and themed rooms.

image.alt: Outdoor stone yard with rows of full slabs and the Raccoon Stone Works truck

steps.title: Visit the yard
steps.text: Come to 2347 GA-247CONN in Byron, walk the full slabs and talk with our team about your kitchen and your budget.

steps.title: Get a quote
steps.text: Customers mention that we answered all their questions and got them a price quote quickly. Bring your measurements or a sketch of the layout.

steps.title: Template visit
steps.text: We come to your home and make a precise template of every counter run, corner and angle. Taking the time here is what makes the fit right.

steps.title: Cut and match
steps.text: We cut your chosen slab in our shop and line up the natural pattern where pieces have to join, especially on angled layouts.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Our installer sets the stone and finishes the joints. Then you check the finished counters with us and tell us if anything needs attention.

items.name: Shawn C.
items.text:
Very professional work and communications all along the journey.   Everyone I interacted with was friendly and helpful.
They had great rapport with the company supplying materials for other features of the kitchen and they coordinated at each step of the redecorating.
Everyone was experienced, knew what they were doing, and wanted their work to be perfect.  The man who actually cut the stone into the pieces for my kitchen, took great pride in matching up the natural patterns where piecing was required- due to the multi-angular layout of my kitchen work space/cabinets. The installer made the joints appear almost seamless!.   It is beautiful!
Totally transparent process and timely at each step; I am extremely pleased with the results of my countertops; the material is beautiful and they found the piece of stone I wanted and made certain I was happy with it before they cut/used it!  Then they made my countertops perfectly!
Overall superb and I will use their services again in the future if ever needed.  I highly recommend Raccoon !

items.name: Michael E.
items.text: Here is what you are going to find with Raccoon... They have the full slabs there at the shop that you can look at.  Other companies in the area have little 1 foot square blocks to look at, even Lowes and Home Depot. Others will send you up to Atlanta where they buy their slabs. (We did that too.) (Very rough neighborhood in Atlanta.)  Hundreds to look at but none of them as nice as those that Raccoon has available.  They are very nice folks and professional.  The guy that came out to our house spent 4 hours there making a template.  When it came time for the install, it was an absolute perfect fit.  We are very picky when it comes to hiring companies. Oh, and their prices beat everyone. We are so pleased with this company and highly recommend them.

items.name: Jj A.
items.text: Absolutely loved my experience with Raccoon Stone & Tile Works! The quality of their work is top-notch, and the attention to detail really shows in the final result. From start to finish, the team was professional, friendly, and incredibly helpful. They made the whole process easy and enjoyable, and I couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. Truly amazing people to work. My buddy actually recommended us to them and I will be coming back for any future needs. Thank you

service_area.h2: Stone countertops in Byron, GA and across central Georgia
service_area.text: Our yard and showroom are at 2347 GA-247CONN in Byron, GA, and we have served central Georgia homeowners from here for years. Come in during the week to see the slabs in person. If you are unsure whether we install at your address, call (478) 956-2222 before your visit and we will tell you. Bring a rough sketch of your layout and we can start talking about stone the same day.

items.q: Can I see the actual slab before you cut it?
items.a: Yes. We keep full slabs at the shop, so you can look at the whole piece instead of a small square sample. One customer said we found the piece of stone she wanted and made certain she was happy with it before we cut it.

items.q: How do you make sure the countertops fit?
items.a: We come to your home and make a template first. One customer said the template visit took four hours and the install was an absolute perfect fit. On layouts with many angles, we also match the stone pattern across the joints.

Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. The showroom and stone yard are at 2347 GA-247CONN in Byron, GA. Call (478) 956-2222 if you would like to check on a slab before you drive over.

items.q: Do you do more than kitchen counters?
items.a: Yes. We have made stone accents for powder rooms and laundry rooms, counters for a themed room in a color we had never fabricated before, and an altar and baptismal font for a church. Tile and flooring are also part of our work.

items.q: How quickly can I get a price?
items.a: Bring your kitchen measurements or a drawing when you visit, or call us. Customers say we answered all their questions and got them a price quote quickly. The final number depends on the slab you choose and the layout we template.

final_cta.text: Visit the yard in Byron or call to get your countertop quote started.
